### Spectacular Conversions
Author: Robert Rothwell
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/spectacular-conversions
Passage: Ezekiel 36:26
Points:
- Dramatic conversion stories highlight God's sovereign power to radically turn lives around.
- The Holy Spirit works just as miraculously through ordinary means like weekly preaching and parental teaching.
- Every person begins with natural spiritual resistance that only divine grace can overcome.
- Replacing an unresponsive heart of stone with a tender heart of flesh makes every conversion a spectacular miracle.
